findings.criterion: Advisory: Windows High Contrast removes box-shadow focus rings
findings.title: Text fields need a high-contrast keyboard focus outline
findings.plain: Keyboard users relying on high-contrast mode may not see where text-field focus is.
findings.fix: Use an explicit outline in normal and forced-colors modes.
findings.verification: Removed outline:none, added a 3px :focus-visible outline and a Highlight system-color override; focused regression test passes.
findings.manual_step: Keyboard-tab through text fields in the installed Hub, including Windows forced-colors.
findings.reverify_note: not machine-verifiable: found by reading or on a device — no script can confirm the fix

findings.title: Primary button hover must preserve label contrast
findings.plain: On the light theme, the primary button hover brightening reduced white text contrast below 4.5:1.
findings.fix: Darken the fill slightly on hover and verify theme pairings.
findings.verification: Changed brightness from 1.08 to .92; default light-token contrast computes 5.19:1, with paired dark/access tokens also above 4.5:1. Added source regression test, Hub design suite 22/22.
findings.manual_step: Render primary buttons at hover in each theme and confirm label readability.
findings.reverify_note: not machine-verifiable: found by reading or on a device — no script can confirm the fix

findings.title: Gesture pictogram strokes should retain contrast
findings.plain: Opacity on the gesture card and SVG motion marks could reduce meaningful graphic strokes below 3:1.
findings.fix: Remove decorative opacity from the pictogram and its motion/repetition strokes.
findings.verification: Removed parent opacity .9 and SVG path opacity .75; the accent token resolves to at least 3.28:1 in the light canvas, with darker/high-contrast pairings also above 3:1. Regression test passes.
findings.manual_step: Inspect gesture examples in light, dark, and Access themes.
